text:
The state is  

\[
|\psi\rangle = 0.5\,|\uparrow\rangle+\frac{\sqrt3}{2}\,|\downarrow\rangle,
\qquad a=0.5,\; b=\frac{\sqrt3}{2}\approx0.8660 .
\]

The Pauli matrices in the \(\{|\uparrow\rangle,|\downarrow\rangle\}\) basis are  

\[
\sigma_z=\begin{pmatrix}1&0\\0&-1\end{pmatrix},\qquad 
\sigma_x=\begin{pmatrix}0&1\\1&0\end{pmatrix}.
\]

Expectation values:

\[
\langle\sigma_z\rangle = |a|^{2}-|b|^{2}=0.25-0.75=-0.5,
\]

\[
\langle\sigma_x\rangle = a^{*}b + a b^{*}=2ab = 2(0.5)(0.8660)=0.8660.
\]

The operator is \(10\sigma_z+5\sigma_x\), so  

\[
\langle 10\sigma_z+5\sigma_x\rangle = 10\langle\sigma_z\rangle + 5\langle\sigma_x\rangle
= 10(-0.5) + 5(0.8660) = -5 + 4.330 = -0.670.
\]

Rounded to one decimal place, this is \(-0.7\).

**Answer: A**.
